title: Aura Join
description: AuraJoin turns normal player joins into cinematic welcome sequences.
body:
# AuraJoin - Modern Join Cinematics for Paper ​

**AuraJoin** gives your Minecraft server a premium first impression with fully configurable join cinematics. Welcome players with animated titles, actionbars, bossbars, sounds, particles, fireworks, broadcasts, potion effects, and more.​

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7df030ed10cba2916d6aa014226599632a84c81.png)

- Configurable join sequences
- First-join welcome sequences
- VIP/Admin sequences with permissions
- Per-world sequence support
- Randomized sequence groups
- Animated bossbars
- Firework effects with HEX colors
- Sounds, particles, titles, actionbars, broadcasts
- Optional PlaceholderAPI support
- Join delay for smoother server loading
- Per-player cooldown to prevent spam
- 5-second invincibility after join and respawn
- Preview command
- Reload command
- Tab completion
- Modern MiniMessage formatting
- Kotlin-based clean plugin structure

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4854eaf7aa9aa773e9828e25afc4c43f5a188473.png)

- /aurajoin help - Shows command help
- /aurajoin reload - Reloads the configuration
- /aurajoin preview - Previews your assigned sequence
- /aurajoin preview <sequence> - Previews a specific sequence
- /aurajoin list - Lists loaded sequences
- /aurajoin info - Shows plugin information

Alias:​

/aj

Permissions:​
- aurajoin.admin
- aurajoin.preview
- aurajoin.cooldown.bypass
- aurajoin.sequence.vip
- aurajoin.sequence.admin

## Why AuraJoin?

​Most join plugins only send a message or title. AuraJoin is built as a real cinematic system. You can define complete step-based sequences, assign them by permission, restrict them to worlds, randomize them, and preview everything ingame.

Perfect for:​
- Lobby servers
- Survival servers
- SMP servers
- Network hubs
- VIP join effects
- First-time player welcomes
- Premium server branding

Requirements:
​
- Paper 1.21.11
- Java 21
- PlaceholderAPI optional
